title: Cheesy Yellow Pepper Sandwich
description: A simple and flavorful sandwich featuring yellow peppers and melted cheese.
instructions: Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the yellow peppers and place them on the bottom slice of bread.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the peppers.
Spread a layer of peppery spread on top of the cheese.
Place the top slice of bread on the sandwich.
Cook the sandwich for 3-4 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is toasted.
